login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to Routy.
login.inactiveError: This account is deactivated. Contact your admin.
login.lockedError: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
login.captchaError: Captcha check failed. Please try again.
login.setupSubtitle: No profile exists yet — create the first account.
login.setupTokenHint: Shown in the console when the container starts — check with "docker compose logs -f".
login.setupTokenError: The setup token is wrong or missing.

profile.title: Create a new profile
profile.subtitle: Every profile has its own stats, but shares access to the same path network.
profile.success: Profile created. You can now sign in.

route.title: Suggest a route
route.noRouteFound: No route found within the configured length range.
route.activeNotice: You have an active route. Confirm it as walked, or discard it to get a new suggestion.
route.discardConfirm: Really discard this route? It won't count as walked.
route.completedMessage: Nice, well done! The route now counts toward your stats.
route.voiceHint: On arrival at a station, announces the next station and its direction (needs "Show my location").
route.voiceArrivedFinal: Arrived at {here}. That was the last station.
route.explorerModeHint: Prefers path segments that have never been walked.
route.favoriteStale: This route includes segments that have since been deleted and can no longer be taken.

share.subtitle: Read-only, shared route.
share.notFoundBody: This link is invalid or is no longer shared.

import.nameConflictWarning: Heads up: a node named "{name}" already exists, but it's {distance} m away. Use it anyway?
import.noTracks: No usable tracks were found in this file.

map.title: Overview
map.subtitle: All known nodes and path segments — click for details.
map.deleteConfirm: Really delete this path segment? It moves to the trash and can be restored from there.
map.interactionHint: Click a path or node to see details and — if you own it or are an admin — actions for it.
map.moveNodeActive: Drag active — drag the node on the map
map.deleteNodeConfirm: Really delete this node and the {count} path segment(s) connected to it? They move to the trash and can be restored from there.
map.deleteBlockedNode: This node can't be deleted — it's currently used by an active route.
map.deleteBlockedSegment: This path can't be deleted — it's currently used by an active route.
map.editBlockedNotOwner: You can't edit this — only whoever created it, or an admin, can.
map.purgeConfirm: Delete permanently? This cannot be undone.
map.autoPurgeNotice: Items in the trash are permanently deleted automatically after 30 days.

overview.interactionHint: Click a path or node to see details and — if you own it or are an admin — actions for it.

record.instructions: Records your path by GPS while you walk. When you're done, save it just like a drawn or imported path.
record.backgroundHint: Only works while this tab/app stays in the foreground and the screen is on — browsers can't reliably record GPS in the background.
record.locationError: Couldn't get your location. Please allow location access.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your profile and personal settings.
settings.networkSubtitle: These values control how generously nodes get merged and how routes are selected. Admins only.
settings.merge_radius_m_hint: Points within this radius are treated as the same node.
settings.name_far_warn_m_hint: Warn when a same-named node is farther away than this.
settings.tolerance_percent_hint: How far a route may deviate from the target length.
settings.widen_step_percent_hint: How much the tolerance grows per "New route" click.
settings.daily_diversity_weight_hint: How strongly paths already walked today are penalized in new suggestions.
settings.walk_speed_kmh_hint: Default for profiles without their own value, and for GPX files with no timestamps.
settings.walkSpeedSubtitle: Overrides the network default for your profile only — affects the estimated duration of new paths and routes.
settings.walkSpeedHint: Leave empty to use the network default (currently {default} km/h).
settings.suggest_min_km_hint: Lower bound of the length range a route is suggested from.
settings.suggest_max_km_hint: Upper bound of the length range a route is suggested from.
settings.adjust_step_percent_hint: How much the route changes on a "Longer" or "Shorter" click.
settings.passwordChangeError: Current password is wrong, or the new password is too short.
settings.logoutEverywhereSubtitle: Signs you out on every other device/browser. This session stays signed in.
settings.loggedOutEverywhere: All other sessions have been signed out.
settings.deleteAccountSubtitle: Your account will be deactivated. Only the admin can reactivate it.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm: Really delete your account? It will be deactivated until an admin reactivates it.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitle: Your walks, and how the path network is used overall.
stats.leaderboardEmpty: Nobody has walked yet this week.
stats.noSegments: No path segments in the network yet.
stats.deleteWalkConfirm: Really delete this walk from your history? Your stats will be adjusted accordingly.

draw.title: Draw on the map
draw.instructions: Click the map to place points. Near a known node (dashed circle) a click snaps to it automatically.
draw.dragHint: Drag a placed point to position it more precisely.

edit.title: Edit path
edit.subtitle: Drag individual points to correct the path's shape, add or remove points, or split the path at a new junction.
edit.splitBlockedActive: This path can't be split right now — it's currently used by an active route.
edit.addPointHint: Click the path to insert a new point there. Click an interior point's marker to remove it again.
edit.splitModeHint: Click the path to split it into two segments at that spot.
edit.renameSegmentHint: Useful when two paths connect the same nodes (e.g. straight vs. around) — the name helps tell them apart.

special.trailblazerDesc: Submitted a path segment of your own

admin.title: User management
admin.subtitle: Create, lock, edit, or delete accounts.
admin.deleteConfirm: Really permanently delete this account? Login credentials are removed; nodes/paths they created stay attributed to their name.
admin.newPasswordHint: Only fill in to reset the password (min. 6 characters).
admin.backupDesc: Download a full copy of the database (a consistent snapshot that doesn't interrupt normal use).
